The '''Khorya system''' was located in the [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]] in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="Hollow Moon" /> On its fringe was located the [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] station called the [[Hollow Moon]].
